subject: S04 console guard follow-up done; agent.spec 54/54 on all three CI browsers
body:
S04 final check, B2 follow-up: console guard fixed and integrated at 4609a60 (note to all 20261117T005259).

apps/web/e2e/fixtures.ts
- "Failed to load resource" lines are never ignored, whatever origin they are attributed to.
- Failed requests are judged by frame, from page.on("response") (status >= 400) and page.on("requestfailed"). Only requests whose request.frame() is the main frame count. Excepted: cancelled requests, deliberately offline ones, and service-worker requests (they have no frame).
- Expected failures still go through allowHttpError (status 0 = failed without a response).
- Other console lines are ignored only when they come from youtube-nocookie.com, youtube.com, google.com or gstatic.com (and their subdomains).
- The new console-guard.spec.ts proves it: a broken cross-origin image (404) and a cross-origin fetch (500) on an app page each fail the guard (expected failures via test.fail). The same failure declared with allowHttpError passes. Rule tests cover embed hosts, failed-resource lines, look-alike hosts and benign failure texts.
- agent.spec's sandbox-only E2E_IGNORE_HTTPS_ERRORS opt-in now covers the whole file. The stricter guard rightly flagged Firefox rejecting the sandbox proxy's certificate for Commons/PMC images during ordinary ping tests. CI has no proxy, so certificates are checked there.

CI for my commit: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43991179545 (4609a60)
- agent.spec: Chromium 54/54, WebKit 54/54, Firefox 54/54.
- console-guard.spec: 18 passes plus 12 expected failures (the guard firing), in every browser.
- The Firefox job is fully green (774 passed). lint/unit/drift/build and integration (db) passed.
- No CI failure comes from the new network check: zero "failed requests of the app's own page" errors in all three logs.
- Still red, not S04 and not caused by the guard:
  - Chromium ink-sync.spec :290 and :365 x 6 projects (an ink erase assertion, a stroke still present). They were red before this change. Owner: seg12b-ink (LWW spec, dc6b1eb / 3fcf24e).
  - WebKit qbank.spec :443 on webkit-ipad-portrait only. qbank.spec's own listener caught "pageerror: …/api/cards/stats?tz=UTC due to access control checks": WebKit rejects a cards-stats fetch that navigation cancelled. Owners: seg08 (qbank spec, see 76a0403) and S10 (cards stats fetch, unhandled rejection).

Local
- Smoke set x2 on agent.spec + console-guard.spec, --retries=0: 56/56 and 56/56.
- firefox-phone-390/412: 14/14 each.
- A whole-suite run on chromium-laptop-1440 showed no failure from the network check. The local reds there are missing local data (no search index, chapter ch01, too few questions); CI seeds and indexes.
- typecheck, vitest, shared and biome clean; API unit and ruff/mypy clean (full gate in the integrate).
